newsArray.title: Babar Azam says he’s ‘90 percent’ fit and set to return for Pakistan in 2nd test against England
newsArray.description: article author: AP Wed, 2026-08-26 18:29 LONDON: Pakistan captain Babar Azam is set to make his return to the team for the second test against England at Lord’s starting Thursday, despite not fully recovering from a finger injury. Babar missed the first test, which England won by an innings and 103 runs at Headingley last week, because of the issue but has taken part in practice sessions at the home of cricket. “Yes, 90 percent I’m fit for tomorrow’s match,” Babar said in a news conference on Wednesday.
